messages:
Maya: Quick sync on the cloud refkit ops doc. Need final infra + partner enablement review today. Essentials: runbook, short Terraform examples, and smoke tests.
Oliver: Which pieces are infra-only vs enablement?
Maya: Infra: autoscale examples, IAM snippets, cost guidance. Enablement: onboarding steps, artifact layout, packaging checklist.
Sarah: I can draft onboarding & partner checklist. Drop the doc link?
Maya: https://redwood.internal/docs/refkit/ops-runbook-draft (view-only). TODOs: single-region TF quickstart, KMS best-practices, canary rollback notes.
Devon: I'll add spot+reserved example and a small smoke harness.
Oliver: Adding autoscale example (to include in doc):
```
resource "redwood_inference_pool" "partner_default" {
  region = "us-east-1"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  min_instances = 1
  max_instances = 8
  spot_percentage = 50
}
```
Alex: Packaging note: image tags must be immutable for marketplace. Partners need to pin tags and supply manifest.json for Verified Models.
Sarah: Checklist items added: account setup, KMS key, VPC checklist, smoke test commands (example: `curl -X POST https://<endpoint>/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'`).
Devon: I'll draft latency SLO guidance and fallback-model notes.
Maya: Also add rollback playbook (flip traffic to hosted fallback, revoke keys, contact list).
Oliver: I'll include cost-estimate guidance and batching recommendations.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: submission cutoff for next packaging window is 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC.
Maya: Plan: PRs by Thu 5pm, internal review Fri, submit Mon. Owners: Alex (packaging), Sarah (partner quickstart), Devon (infra examples), Oliver (cost/autoscale). PRs to the draft doc please. Thanks :sparkles:
